Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(varCurrentSetup.Status.Value), RGBA(161, 159, 157, 1),
    varCurrentSetup.Status.Value = "Operational", RGBA(16, 124, 16, 1),
    RGBA(196, 116, 0, 1)
)

"ASSETS IN THIS SETUP" &
If(
    CountRows(galSetupAssets.AllItems) = 0,
    "",
    "   (" & CountRows(galSetupAssets.AllItems) & ")"
)

"No assets carry this setup. An asset belongs here when its Setup field reads exactly """
 & Coalesce(varCurrentSetup.Titel, "?") & """."

With(
    { q: Lower(Trim(txtSetupAddSearch.Text)) },
    FirstN(
        Sort(
            Filter(
                Equipment_Assets,
                !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(DeviceName, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Manufacturer, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(SerialNumber, ""))))
            ),
            Titel
        ),
        25
    )
)
"Nothing chosen yet - type below to search"
If(Parent.Width < 600, "Search ID, device, maker", "Type to search by ID, device or manufacturer")

If(
    IsEmpty(colSetupAddPick),
    "Add to setup",
    "Add " & CountRows(colSetupAddPick) & " to setup"
)

Filter(
    Setup_Documents,
    Not('{IsFolder}'),
    EndsWith('{Path}', "/" & varCurrentSetup.Titel & "/")
        || SetupID = varCurrentSetup.Titel
)

Max(
    CountRows(
        Filter(
            Setup_Documents,
            Not('{IsFolder}'),
            EndsWith('{Path}', "/" & varCurrentSetup.Titel & "/")
                || SetupID = varCurrentSetup.Titel
        )
    ),
    1
) * 40

Coalesce(varRemoveFromSetup.Titel, "") & " - " &
 Coalesce(varRemoveFromSetup.DeviceName, "") &
 " is taken out of " & Coalesce(varCurrentSetup.Titel, "") & "." &
 Char(10) & Char(10) &
 "The device itself is not deleted, and its other setups stay as they are."
